newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for second veg oil tender.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for second veg oil tender.

text.p: Egypt extended the deadline to buy between 15,000 and 25,000 tonnes of vegetable oils for delivery in the first half of March to January 21, an official from the state Holding Company for Food Industries said on Wednesday.
Head of sales Muharram Ghanem told Reuters the original deadline was January 14. He said Egypt wanted to buy the following-
-- 10,000-15,000 tonnes +/- five percent of sunflower oil and/or cottonseed oil
-- 5,000-10,000 tonnes +/- five percent of soybean oil.
